decision.explanation: The question asks for the main character in the video game 'Who Framed Roger Rabbit.' The provided sources distinguish between two versions of the game. Document D1S3 states that the player controls Roger Rabbit in the 1988 version. Document D2S5 indicates that the player controls Eddie Valiant in the 1989 version. Both characters are valid as main characters in their respective versions of the game. Since the question does not specify which version, both answers are preserved as distinct valid referents.
